Forsig

Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 23, 2026

Forsig is building a budget firewall and control layer for AI agents. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when you visit our website, join the waitlist, contact us, use referral features, or participate in the private beta.

This policy is written for our early-access launch. As Forsig evolves, we will update this page to reflect the product and our data practices.

Who We Are

Forsig is operated by Nazmul Karim. You can contact us at thenazmulkarim@gmail.com or through the contact page.

Information We Collect

We collect information you choose to provide, including your email address, name, company, role, provider usage, monthly token volume or AI spend, use case, contact messages, referral code, and referral invite recipients.

We also collect technical and analytics information, such as pages visited, UTM parameters, referrer, browser and device information, viewport size, approximate request metadata, timestamps, and basic server logs.

If you participate in the Forsig beta product, we may process product metadata such as agent identifiers, model names, token counts, estimated costs, status codes, latency, block reasons, budget settings, policy notes, and audit events.

Prompt And Traffic Data

Forsig is designed around a metadata-first privacy posture. Prompts and model responses are not stored by default in the MVP. We may temporarily process request data only as needed to route, authorize, meter, block, or debug requests. If prompt logging is introduced later, it will be presented as an explicit product setting or feature with clear controls.

Provider Keys And Virtual Keys

In the planned product, users may provide AI provider API keys so Forsig can route authorized requests through a Forsig virtual key. Provider keys are intended to be stored server-side and encrypted before storage. We do not sell provider keys or use them to train models.

How We Use Information

We use information to operate the waitlist, send confirmations and referral emails, respond to messages, prioritize beta access, understand demand, improve the website and product, detect abuse, troubleshoot issues, and communicate about Forsig.

For beta product data, we use metadata to enforce budgets, model rules, kill switches, audit logs, token counting, request visibility, and policy decisions.

Emails And Referrals

When you join the waitlist, we may email you confirmation, product updates, launch information, and beta access details. If you invite someone by referral, we send the invite email to the addresses you enter and include your email address as the inviter. If someone accepts your referral, we may notify you that your referral was accepted.

Analytics

We use analytics tools such as PostHog to understand website usage, conversion events, referral performance, and product interest. Analytics may use cookies or similar technologies. We configure analytics to support product improvement and launch measurement, not to sell personal information.

Service Providers

We use service providers to host the site, store waitlist records, send emails, and measure analytics. These may include Vercel, Supabase or another Postgres provider, Resend, PostHog, domain/DNS providers, and similar infrastructure vendors. They process information on our behalf to provide these services.

Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers, when required by law, to protect Forsig or users, to prevent abuse, or as part of a merger, acquisition, financing, or business transfer.

Retention

We keep waitlist and contact information for as long as needed to operate the beta, evaluate product interest, communicate with you, and maintain business records. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

Your Choices

You may request access, correction, deletion, or opt out of non-essential emails by contacting thenazmulkarim@gmail.com. We may need to retain limited information where required for security, legal, or operational reasons.

Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect information. No system is perfectly secure, especially during an early beta. Please do not send sensitive secrets through contact forms or waitlist fields.

International Users

Forsig may process information in countries other than where you live. By using Forsig, you understand that information may be transferred to and processed by our infrastructure and service providers.

Children

Forsig is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

Changes

We may update this policy as Forsig changes. The updated date above will show when the policy was last revised.
